Automated Model Briefing

⚠ AI-generated text — may be wrong, incomplete, or overconfident. This is automated commentary on experimental model output, not flight advice and not a weather forecast. It has not been reviewed by a meteorologist.

Overall Assessment — A wet, overcast day with widespread rain (peak 15.9 mm/hr) and 100% cloud cover across all sites. Thermal lift is suppressed by precipitation and clouds, with peak w* reaching only 237–311 ft/min at the lower sites. The regional lapse rate is steep (9.1 °C/km) and several sites show sharp-thermal potential, but rain, overdevelopment, and gusty SW flow make all launches unflyable today.

Site Breakdown

  • Kingsbury grade: Unfavorable — rain and 100% cloud cover all day; light variable winds. No flyable window (theoretical 11am–1pm, peak w* 237 ft/min, thermal ceiling 1602 ft AGL). Lapse rate 7.7 °C/km.
  • Hallelujah: Unfavorable — rain, strong off‑direction SE wind (13–17 mph gusting 20), hazardous low‑level shear (5 mph speed shear at 579 ft, bulk shear 25 mph). Theoretical window 11am–2pm (peak w* 311 ft/min, ceiling 3115 ft AGL). Sharp‑thermal caution: lapse rate 8.7 °C/km.
  • Slide Mountain: Unfavorable — rain, overdevelopment 77%, crosswind SW–SSW 10–17 mph. Theoretical window 9:30am–4pm (peak w* 304 ft/min, ceiling 1871 ft AGL). Lapse 7.8 °C/km.
  • McClellan: Unfavorable — rain, directional shear 39° hazardous, light winds. Theoretical window 10am–4pm (peak w* 301 ft/min, ceiling 2159 ft AGL). Lapse 7.9 °C/km.
  • West McClellan: Unfavorable — rain, off‑direction SE wind 12 mph, hazardous shear (5 mph speed shear, 36° dir change). Theoretical window 10am–2pm (peak w* 300 ft/min, ceiling 2038 ft AGL). Lapse 7.7 °C/km.
  • Peavine Mountain: Unfavorable — rain, strong SW wind gusting 22 mph, overdevelopment 77%. Theoretical window 11am–3pm (peak w* 267 ft/min, ceiling 2483 ft AGL). Lapse 7.3 °C/km.
  • Rainbow Ridge: Unfavorable — rain, hazardous shear (7 mph speed shear at 934 ft, 35° dir change), wind E–SE 6–16 mph. Theoretical window 11am–5pm (peak w* 284 ft/min, ceiling 2649 ft AGL). Lapse 7.9 °C/km.
  • Duck Hill: Unfavorable — rain, off‑direction wind SE until 4pm then NW; sharp‑thermal lapse 8.1 °C/km. Theoretical window 10am–8pm (peak w* 300 ft/min, ceiling 2152 ft AGL), best evening ridge potential if rain stops.
  • Daydreams: Unfavorable — rain, 100% overdevelopment, strong SW wind gusting 24 mph, sharp‑thermal lapse 8.2 °C/km. Continuous thermal lift 8am–9pm but unflyable.

Hazards

  • Rain: Widespread precipitation up to 15.9 mm/hr; all sites report 100% cloud cover and rain during flying hours.
  • Overdevelopment: LCL within 10% of PBLH at many sites — Daydreams 100%, Slide Mountain 77%, Peavine Mountain 77%, Hallelujah 45%, Rainbow Ridge 55%, West McClellan 18%, McClellan 5%.
  • Low‑level shear: Hazardous speed shear ≥5 mph/layer at Hallelujah (5 mph at 579 ft), Slide Mountain (5 mph at 396 ft), West McClellan (5 mph at 404 ft), Peavine Mountain (5 mph at 235 ft), Rainbow Ridge (7 mph at 934 ft). Directional shear ≥30° at McClellan (39°), West McClellan (36°), Rainbow Ridge (35°). Bulk shear 10m–500m AGL up to 25 mph (Hallelujah, Slide Mountain).
  • Rotor/lee turbulence: Gusty SW surface flow up to 23 mph (Daydreams 24 mph gust, Peavine 22 mph) creates rotor risk downwind of Peavine Mtn and Carson Range.
  • Icing: Freezing level 8,575 ft MSL; possible if pilots approach cloud base (LCL 4,154–11,121 ft MSL), though most thermal ceilings remain below 3,115 ft AGL.
  • Sharp thermals: Regional lapse rate 9.1 °C/km; site‑specific >8 °C/km at Hallelujah (8.7), Duck Hill (8.1), Daydreams (8.2). Advanced pilots only if any lift is encountered.

Site Forecast ?Top of Thermals (PBLH) — height of the turbulent mixing layer; thermals typically reach this ceiling.
LCL (Lifted Condensation Level) — altitude where rising air reaches its dew point; theoretical cloud base.
Cloud Base — lowest model level with >10% cloud fraction.
w* — convective velocity scale; higher = stronger thermals (ft/min).
Cloud Cover — max cloud fraction over the column (0–100%).
Wind thresholds: orange = 12 mph, red = 18 mph.
